## Ticket

Link the `docs/tickets/CSH-...` file. Keep it at `review` until integration.

## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Identify any remaining scope in
linked follow-up tickets.

## Validation

Record the commands and outcomes relevant to the acceptance criteria, including
the platform and any checks that could not be run.

## Documentation

Link updated architecture, usage, or POSIX coverage notes when applicable.
